groups.title: Fixture case study: Lantern Street Bakery

exhibits.title: Background
exhibits.body:
Engineering fixture, not certification material.

Lantern Street Bakery is a fictional family business with three shops. It bakes everything at one central kitchen and delivers to its shops before they open each morning.

The owners want to open a fourth shop next year without adding night-shift staff.

exhibits.title: Current environment
exhibits.body:
Orders are written in a shared notebook at each shop.

The kitchen runs two ovens and one van.

Shop managers telephone the kitchen before closing to confirm the next day.

Prices are printed on paper cards and updated by hand.

exhibits.title: Business requirements
exhibits.body:
Each shop must have fresh bread before opening.

Waste must fall by a fifth within a year.

Customers must be able to pre-order for special occasions.

Staff must not need to stay later than they do today.

exhibits.title: Technical requirements
exhibits.body:
Order changes must reach the kitchen by four in the afternoon.

Deliveries must be planned so that the van makes one trip.

Records must be kept for two years.

exhibits.title: Issues
exhibits.body:
The notebook is sometimes unreadable.

The kitchen often bakes too much on Mondays.

One shop regularly runs out of rolls by midday.

The van is sometimes late because of school traffic.

exhibits.title: Background
exhibits.body:
Engineering fixture, not certification material.

Northgate Tool Library is a fictional charity that lends tools to local residents. It has one workshop, four hundred members and a team of volunteers.

The charity wants members to borrow more often while keeping every tool safe to use.

exhibits.title: Current environment
exhibits.body:
Tools are stored on open shelves.

Loans are recorded on paper slips.

Volunteers check tools when they have time.

Members reserve tools by telephone.

exhibits.title: Business requirements
exhibits.body:
Members must be able to see which tools are available.

Every tool must be safety checked between loans.

Volunteers must spend less time on paperwork.

exhibits.title: Technical requirements

A tool that fails a check must not be available to borrow.

Records must be kept for one year.

exhibits.title: Issues
exhibits.body:
Paper slips are sometimes lost.

Some tools are lent twice on the same day.

Damaged tools can stay on the shelf for weeks.
